// TestDecolorizer rows adapted from Grafana Loki, copyright Grafana Labs contributors.
// The other inputs are Pulse-authored controls; see README.md for the source pin.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// Build this file as a .go source, then pass the pinned pkg/logql/log/fmt.go
// as the first argument. No Pulse implementation participates in the oracle.
func main() {
	source, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	check(err)
	_, literal, found := strings.Cut(string(source), "const ansiPattern = ")
	if !found {
		panic("missing source pattern")
	}
	literal, _, _ = strings.Cut(literal, "\n")
	pattern, err := strconv.Unquote(literal)
	check(err)
	r := regexp.MustCompile(pattern)
	row := func(name, line string) map[string]string {
		return map[string]string{"name": name, "line": line, "expected": r.ReplaceAllString(line, "")}
	}
	upstream := []map[string]string{
		row("uncolored text remains the same", "sample text"),
		row("colored text loses color", "\033[0;32mgreen\033[0m \033[0;31mred\033[0m"),
	}
	inputs := []string{
		"", "plain λ 日本語\ntext", "\x1b", "before\x1b[after", "before\x1b[", "before\x1b[?",
		"before\x1b[☃after", "\x1b[31☃tail", "\x1b[31\nnew", "\x1b[99999mX", "\x1b[999999mX",
		"\x1b[38:5:123mred", "\x1b[1;2345mX", "\x1b[1;23456mX", "\x1b[1;;mX", "\x1b[1;;;X",
		"\x1b[31mhello\x07tail", "\x1b[hello;world\x07tail", "\x1b]0;Title\x07tail", "\x1b]hello:world\x07tail",
		"\u009b31mred\u009b0m", "\u009b", "\u009b[", "\u009b[☃tail", "\x1b\\mkeep",
		"\x1b[[()#;?31mred", "\x1b[31m\x1b[", "\x1b[\x1b[31mtext", "a\x1b[dTEXT", "a\x1b[eTEXT",
		"\x1b[0;\x1b[32mgreen", "\x1b[hello!text\x07tail", "\x1b[1;2;3;4mtext", "\x1b[1;2;3;4Stext",
	}
	controls := []map[string]string{}
	for i, input := range inputs {
		controls = append(controls, row("boundary-"+strconv.Itoa(i), input))
	}
	for c := 32; c <= 126; c++ {
		controls = append(controls, row("terminal-"+strconv.Itoa(c), "left\x1b[12;3"+string(rune(c))+"right"))
	}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	check(encoder.Encode(map[string]any{"upstream": upstream, "controls": controls}))
}

func check(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
